source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
While the only units from your army within **[Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)** of an enemy unit are **FORTIFICATIONS**:

- that enemy unit can still be targeted by ranged attacks, but each such attack not made with a [Pistol](vsdata:weapon-ability/pistol) subtracts 1 from its **[Hit roll](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls)**
- when that enemy unit [Falls Back](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back) while **Battle-shocked**, its models skip the **[Desperate Escape Test](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape)** unless they will move across enemy models
